name: Live poll
description: Run a quick poll with options, vote counts, and reporting/export hooks.
instructions: For the Live poll template, support reusable poll-specific voting links. Store polls, options, and votes app-scoped. Public voting links use ?poll=<slug-or-id>; respondent identity comes from the logged-in Hangar user, with optional &email=<email> retained only as a legacy fallback. Do not ask voters to type their email or leave comments. Use Google Sheets for result exports and chat/LLM helpers for summarizing results.
